package unit

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestInferTaskCapabilitiesUsesValidationContractForAPIStage(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "api", "engine": "node.express", "mode": "both"},
			{"id": "http", "engine": "http.runtime", "mode": "final"}
		]
	}`)

	caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities("HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT", contract, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("infer capabilities: %v", err)
	}

	if caps.Type != domain.TaskTypeAPIEndpoint {
		t.Fatalf("expected api endpoint task type, got %d", caps.Type)
	}

	if caps.ExecutionMode != domain.TaskExecutionModeHTTPAPI {
		t.Fatalf("expected http api execution mode, got %d", caps.ExecutionMode)
	}

	if !caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected live validation to stay enabled because api stage is live/both")
	}
}

func TestInferTaskCapabilitiesDisablesLiveValidationWhenAllStagesFinal(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "php", "engine": "php.core", "mode": "final"},
			{"id": "css", "engine": "css.ast", "mode": "final"}
		]
	}`)

	caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities("PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT", contract, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("infer capabilities: %v", err)
	}

	if caps.Type != domain.TaskTypeFullstackPage {
		t.Fatalf("expected fullstack task type, got %d", caps.Type)
	}

	if caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected live validation to be disabled when all stages are final-only")
	}
}

func TestInferTaskCapabilitiesEnablesLiveValidationForPHPCoreBothStage(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "php", "engine": "php.core", "mode": "both"}
		]
	}`)

	caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities("PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT", contract, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("infer capabilities: %v", err)
	}

	if !caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected php.core both stage to enable live validation")
	}
}

func TestValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapabilityRejectsFinalOnlyContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "php", "engine": "php.core", "mode": "final"},
			{"id": "css", "engine": "css.ast", "mode": "both"}
		]
	}`)

	if err := domain.ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(contract, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected final-only php.core to reject advertised live validation")
	}
	if err := domain.ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(contract, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected final-only php.core without live capability to pass: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapabilityAcceptsLiveContractAndLegacyPayload(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	liveContract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "php", "engine": "php.core", "mode": "live"},
			{"id": "runtime", "engine": "linux.runtime", "mode": "final"}
		]
	}`)
	if err := domain.ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(liveContract, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected live php.core contract to pass: %v", err)
	}

	legacy := json.RawMessage(`{"type":"php_script","rules":{"required_constructs":[{"type":"echo"}]}}`)
	if err := domain.ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(legacy, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected legacy PHP payload to keep compatibility: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestInferTaskCapabilitiesTreatsNextJSFoundationAsFullstack(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "next", "engine": "nextjs.app", "mode": "final"}
		]
	}`)

	caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities("NEXTJS_BASIC", contract, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("infer capabilities: %v", err)
	}

	if caps.Type != domain.TaskTypeFullstackPage {
		t.Fatalf("expected fullstack page task type, got %d", caps.Type)
	}

	if caps.ExecutionMode != domain.TaskExecutionModeBrowserPreview {
		t.Fatalf("expected browser preview execution mode, got %d", caps.ExecutionMode)
	}

	if caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected nextjs foundation to stay final-only")
	}
}

func TestInferTaskCapabilitiesTreatsPHPFrameworkFoundationAsFullstack(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "laravel", "engine": "php.laravel", "mode": "final"}
		]
	}`)

	caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities("PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT", contract, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("infer capabilities: %v", err)
	}

	if caps.Type != domain.TaskTypeFullstackPage {
		t.Fatalf("expected fullstack page task type, got %d", caps.Type)
	}

	if caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected php framework foundation to stay final-only")
	}
}

func TestInferTaskCapabilitiesTreatsTypeScriptRuntimeCompositeAsLiveCLI(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "static", "engine": "ts.ast", "mode": "both"},
			{"id": "runtime", "engine": "ts.runtime", "mode": "final", "depends_on": ["static"]}
		]
	}`)

	caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities("TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT", contract, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("infer capabilities: %v", err)
	}
	if caps.Type != domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming || caps.ExecutionMode != domain.TaskExecutionModeTerminalRun {
		t.Fatalf("expected CLI programming capabilities, got %+v", caps)
	}
	if !caps.RequiresSandbox || !caps.ExposesTerminal || caps.ExposesPreview {
		t.Fatalf("expected terminal sandbox capabilities, got %+v", caps)
	}
	if !caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected live validation from ts.ast stage")
	}
}

func TestInferTaskCapabilitiesTreatsJavaCompileRuntimeCompositeAsLiveCLI(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	contract := json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [
			{"id": "compile", "engine": "java.compile", "mode": "both"},
			{"id": "runtime", "engine": "java.runtime", "mode": "final", "depends_on": ["compile"]}
		]
	}`)

	caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities("JAVA_BASIC_SCRIPT", contract, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("infer capabilities: %v", err)
	}
	if caps.Type != domain.TaskTypeCLIProgramming || caps.ExecutionMode != domain.TaskExecutionModeTerminalRun {
		t.Fatalf("expected CLI programming capabilities, got %+v", caps)
	}
	if !caps.RequiresSandbox || !caps.ExposesTerminal || caps.ExposesPreview {
		t.Fatalf("expected terminal sandbox capabilities, got %+v", caps)
	}
	if !caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected live validation from java.compile stage")
	}
}
